headline: If adopted, this House resolution would have formally condemned Representative Paul Gosar over his actions concerning attendance at the State of the Union address.
what_it_does: This resolution would have stated the House of Representatives' disapproval of Representative Paul Gosar's actions regarding attendance at the State of the Union address. It would have expressed the House's position but would not have created any penalty, fine, or legal requirement. The House voted on February 6, 2018 to table it, which ended the measure without adoption.

who_it_affects.how: As the member named in the resolution, he would have been formally condemned by the House.
